{{Top|leg}}
The '''Corellian Slavers Guild''' was a [[Slavery/Legends|slaver]] guild that bought, sold and captured slaves in the [[Rim Worlds]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It was owned and operated by the family of the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Iris Snow]], and Snow eventually became the seventh-generation leader of the organization.
